description: Land Acquisition - Theliyagonna and Ambalanpitiya, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Nailiya, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations of multiple land lots. The content is signed by the Minister of Lands but does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities - it solely concerns land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
